hook: Omar Courtz: a decade to be *new*
dek: From a SoundCloud upload and a clothing store job to Billboard's New Artist of the Year. Here's how he built it.

slides.label: The win
slides.text: On Oct. 22 in Miami, Billboard named Omar Courtz *New Artist of the Year* at the 2026 Latin Music Awards. He also took *Latin Rhythm Album of the Year* for "Por Si Mañana No Estoy."

slides.label: The night
slides.text: Telemundo's tally gives him *two awards* on a night when Bad Bunny took seven. Two is not seven, but for a first win in front of the industry, it is *a statement*.

slides.label: The register
slides.text: Born Joshua Omar Medina Cortés in *Carolina, Puerto Rico*, he worked at a clothing store called Change as a teen, where he met *Farruko, Anuel AA and Ozuna*, later collaborators.

slides.label: The grind
slides.text: In *2017* he uploaded "Volvemos Otra Vez" to SoundCloud. A year later came the EP "Invierno," released while he studied *mechanical engineering*. Engineering by day, verses at night.

slides.label: The breakout
slides.text: In 2020, "En Su Nota" went viral during lockdown and led to a deal with Pitbull's *Mr. 305*. His 2024 debut album, "Primera Musa," hit No. 8 on Billboard's Latin albums chart and *No. 1 in Spain*.

slides.label: The album
slides.text: "Por Si Mañana No Estoy" debuted at *No. 1* on Spotify's Top Albums Debut Global chart and placed 11 tracks on Hot Latin Songs. LaMezcla reported *1.4 billion* streams by July.

slides.label: New York
slides.text: "KOKO" hit No. 1 in Spain and powered millions of TikTok videos. His USA tour booked *Barclays Center* on Sept. 9, an arena date for an artist on his *second album*.

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: The "new artist" label undersells him. Retail job, SoundCloud upload, engineering classes, viral hit, label deal, album. That is not luck. That is a plan. *Study the sequence, not the spike*.

"New" is doing a lot of work in Omar Courtz's new title. He has been building in public for nearly a decade.

On Oct. 22 in Miami, Billboard named the Puerto Rican singer New Artist of the Year at the 2026 Latin Music Awards, and he won Latin Rhythm Album of the Year for "Por Si Mañana No Estoy." The path: a teen job at a clothing store where he met Farruko, Anuel AA and Ozuna, a 2017 SoundCloud upload, an EP while studying mechanical engineering, and a 2020 viral hit, "En Su Nota," that led to a deal with Pitbull's Mr. 305. His 2026 album debuted at No. 1 on Spotify's Top Albums Debut Global chart, LaMezcla reported 1.4 billion streams by July, and his tour booked Barclays Center on Sept. 9.

For scale: Telemundo's tally gives him two awards on a night when Bad Bunny took seven.

caption_linkedin:
Omar Courtz's Billboard New Artist of the Year win is a case study in sequencing, not overnight success.

The Puerto Rican singer built his first network working retail, uploaded to SoundCloud in 2017, released an EP while studying mechanical engineering, and turned a 2020 viral hit into a deal with Pitbull's Mr. 305. TikTok's Elevate program, high-profile features and a debut album followed before the 2026 breakout.

"Por Si Mañana No Estoy" debuted at No. 1 on Spotify's Top Albums Debut Global chart, passed a billion streams by April per Live Nation, and supported an arena date at Barclays Center on his second album.

What does his path teach builders outside music about compounding small wins?

By The Innovators Den. Sources: El Comercio, Telemundo, Live Nation, LaMezcla, Wikipedia.
